title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain: (6,2) STNFS on a twisted C4 base field behind a run gate (B=2^71 + 2^25 PF + FILT_EXCESS=1.00 + 40k contam): expected work 2^114.973552035558 G1 units

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns the exact scalar x in 0..r-1 with [x]P0=T with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT, at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)x10x(2^113.0085059606+2^66) < 2^114.973552035558 G1 units (C=2,000; 10x the C_core=20,000 dense-Fp12 core 2^111.651623940670): an expectation over the challenge and the coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7202073246512176891, (K/2^64) x 0.998911 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.998911 and costs at most 2^125.224794023188 G1 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
